question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She was trying to help that little boy in the grocery ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Store'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, the sentence wants to say that a girl was trying to help a little boy who was in a grocery** shop**.
 
• So, the correct word to fill in the blank should have a meaning similar to ***'Shop'***.
 
• **Store** means *a shop of any size or kind.*
 
 
• **For Example** - Apple Store, health-food store, etc.
 
 
 
• So, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **'Store'.**

 Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Store'.**

**The Correct Sentence is: **She was trying to help that little boy in the grocery **store**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the other options:
 
 
• The **road** is an open way for vehicles, persons, and animals. (सड़क)
 
• An **asylum** is an institution providing care and protection to needy individuals (such as the infirm or destitute) and especially the mentally ill. (पागलखाना)
 
• A **park** is a large public garden or area of land used for recreation. (उद्यान)
